title: Service Credit Policy for the CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan
content:
The CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan grants service credits for a missed lab turnaround, recalibrates free of charge an instrument that fails because of a Corbett calibration error, and credits the plan fee refund due on cancellation. Each credit is issued to the customer's Commercial Credit Account as a credit memo.

## Policy

1. **Late turnaround.** When Corbett returns an instrument later than the tier's standard turnaround in business days (or the tier's rush turnaround for a rush) after receipt at the lab, the plan is credited the tier's late turnaround credit percent of that calibration's price at the tier's standard unit price per unit, rounded half up to the cent; delays caused by a pending repair quote do not count.
2. **Calibration error.** An instrument found out of tolerance within the tier's free recalibration window in days after its calibration because of a Corbett calibration error is recalibrated with no units consumed and no charge.
3. **Cancellation refund.** A cancellation refund under the plan's renewal and cancellation terms is credited by credit memo as a plan fee credit.
4. **One late credit per work order.** Each work order receives at most one late turnaround credit. Whether one has already been granted is read from the credits recorded under the same work order.

## Late turnaround in figures (hypothetical)

A calibration consuming 3 units, on a tier with a standard unit price of 64.50 and a late turnaround credit of 15 percent:

- the calibration price is 3 units multiplied by 64.50, which is 193.50;
- 15 percent of 193.50 is 29.025;
- rounded half up to the cent, the credit is 29.03.

## Turnaround boundary (hypothetical standard turnaround of 7 business days, not a rush)

| Return shipment | Credit for late turnaround |
|---|---|
| on the 7th business day after receipt at the lab | none; the turnaround is met |
| on the 8th business day after receipt at the lab | granted |

For a rush calibration the same comparison is made against the tier's rush turnaround.

## Basis Q&A

- *Do the days an instrument waits on a repair quote count toward the turnaround?* No. Delays caused by a pending repair quote do not count.
- *Can a second late turnaround credit be granted on the same work order?* No. Each work order receives at most one late turnaround credit.
- *Does a free recalibration after a Corbett calibration error use prepaid units?* No units are consumed and nothing is charged.
- *How is the cancellation refund booked?* As a credit memo, credited as a plan fee credit.
